name: TESLA MINI BOT
description: Modular WhatsApp bot worker with PostgreSQL-backed sessions. Requires a durable PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.

OWNER_NUMBERS.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp owner numbers in international digits-only format.

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Optional phone number in international digits only; used only for the first WhatsApp pairing.

SESSION_ID.description: Optional PostgreSQL auth-session namespace. Leave unset to reuse the existing default session; set a stable label to isolate another linked WhatsApp session.

AUTO_REPLY.description: Optional. Set to true to enable AI replies to incoming text in direct WhatsApp chats; requires OPENAI_API_KEY in Config Vars.
